_reviewerNote: I don't have a runtime subagent/task identity, so every reviewer.task is null. You need to supply the real task identity before running stage-review record, because the CLI rejects records without one. No request file had an 'instructions' field. I used the response format that cli/stage-review.mjs prepare emits and record validates: request, reviewer, status, observations (2 or more), issues. What I actually read: the full 05-1 request JSON; grep extracts of the scene and production fields from the 06-1 and 07-1 requests, which carry the page 6 and page 7 script blocks; the file lists of all twelve requests, each of which lists its own panel PNG plus page-0N.svg. I opened these images with Read and looked at them: assets/characters/main-cast.png, assets/characters/vision-cast.png, assets/panels/04-2.png, 04-3.png, 05-1 to 05-4, 06-1 to 06-4 and 07-1 to 07-4. I did not open source/original.txt, nurse.png, checkin-patients.png or the storyboard SVGs (page-05/06/07.svg). The Nurse, Mr. Raman and Priya do not appear in these panels. I inspected each PNG at the size Read displayed it and did not zoom in further.

observations: Ananya, seated at left, matches main-cast.png: low bun with loose strands, gold stud, almond eyes with heavy lids, level brows, oval face. She wears a teal kurta under an open white coat with the stethoscope around her neck and not in use.

Hands match the production plan. Ananya's left hand (the far arm, screen-right of her torso) is an open palm toward Ravi, and her right hand rests flat on the desk. Ravi's left hand, wearing the wristwatch, grips the armrest on screen right, and his right hand rests on his knee.

Ravi at right matches the sheet: side-parted short hair, thick straight brows, trimmed beard, light green shirt with rolled sleeves, dark trousers. His dark-brown shoulder bag is on the floor beside the chair at bottom right, consistent with 04-2, where it sat on the floor of the vitals corner.

Tablet boundary: there is no tablet anywhere in the frame or on the desk. The closed silver laptop is pushed to the left edge of the desk. The handoff from 04-3 (Ananya holding the tablet) to the tablet being put away works.

The room carries over from 04-3: bright wall, window with greenery, a potted plant on the sill. The details differ. In 04-3 Ananya's chair is dark grey, here it is blue, and the striped plant pot becomes a white pot with trailing pothos. This is a minor background variance and does not break the reading of the same room on the same visit. There is no text in the frame.
In the left foreground, the back of Ananya's head shows the low bun, gold stud and white-coat shoulder, with a dark line that reads as the stethoscope tube. This matches the 'head' speaker setup.

Ravi faces screen-left toward the doctor. His right hand, on the screen-left arm, rubs the back of his neck. His left hand, with the watch, rests on his knee. Both match the production plan. His face traits (creased eyes, thick brows, square bearded jaw) match the sheet.
His expression is a sheepish open-mouthed smile. That leans more cheerful than 'slightly tired', but it fits the 'a little sheepish' direction and shows no diagnosis or medical claim.
The closed laptop sits on the desk behind. There is no tablet. The window and plant use a blue-striped pot like 04-3. No text.

Minor non-blocking variance: the patient chair here is a blue office chair with black plastic armrests, while 05-1 shows a wooden-armed armchair with a blue cushion. The bag is out of frame, which is acceptable for this framing.

Ananya leans slightly forward at the desk with her hands folded on the desktop and a gentle closed-mouth smile. Small nod marks beside her head show the mid-nod moment. Her face traits, low bun, gold stud, teal kurta, white coat and stethoscope around her neck all match the sheet.
The back of Ravi's head (short dark hair, beard edge visible) and his green-shirted shoulder fill the right foreground. This keeps the Ananya-left / Ravi-right screen direction from 05-1.

The hands are folded and stacked with no extra or fused fingers visible. At this display size I could not confirm which hand is on top (the plan has right over left). That is acceptable for a folded-hands pose.

The closed laptop edge is visible at bottom left, and there is no tablet. A pen cup and a blank blue folder sit at left with no text. Ananya's chair is dark grey here, as in 04-3, against blue in 05-1 and 05-4. This is a minor background variance.

Two-shot that mirrors 05-1. Ananya at left makes an open reassuring gesture with her left hand, and her right hand rests on the desk. Ravi at right nods (nod marks beside his head) with both hands on his knees and the watch on his left wrist.

The bag sits on the floor beside Ravi's chair at bottom right, consistent with 05-1 and set up for being back on his shoulder in 06-1. The closed laptop is on the desk. There is no tablet, no prescription and no instrument in use. The stethoscope stays around her neck.
Identities match the sheets for both characters. The window and plant are present. No text.
Minor non-blocking variance: the patient chair is again drawn differently, a blue-framed chair with wooden legs and different from both 05-1 and 05-2. The reading flow is unaffected.
Back at reception: desk, a monitor seen at an angle (dark, no content), keyboard, teal waiting chairs with figures seen from behind. This works as the place change out of the consultation room.
